summary: KKSS (97.3 FM) is a commercial radio station licensed to Santa Fe, New Mexico, serving the Santa Fe and Albuquerque area. It airs an urban-leaning rhythmic Top 40 format branded as "Kiss 97.3". The station is owned by American General Media, with studios in Northeast Albuquerque and its transmitter tower west of Los Alamos.
one_line: KKSS (97.3 FM) is a Santa Fe, New Mexico commercial radio station airing the urban-leaning rhythmic Top 40 format "Kiss 97.3".
key_facts: KKSS is a commercial radio station operating at 97.3 FM.
KKSS is located in Santa Fe, New Mexico.
KKSS broadcasts to the Santa Fe and Albuquerque, New Mexico, area.
KKSS airs an urban-leaning rhythmic Top 40 music format.
The KKSS format is branded as "Kiss 97.3".
KKSS is owned by American General Media.
The KKSS studios are located in Northeast Albuquerque, a mile north of Central Avenue.
The KKSS transmitter tower is located west of Los Alamos.
